kp_title: KP 1. Identifying Subspaces of Polynomial Vector Spaces
raw_html:
1.?

Consider the vector space R4[t] of all polynomials in the variable t of degree at most 4, and its subset B={p(t)∈R4[t]|p(0)=1}.

Which of the following statements are true?

  1. B is closed under polynomial addition
  2. B is closed under scalar multiplication
  3. B is a subspace of R4[t]
  4. B is not a subspace of R4[t]
